Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 2227 of 2023
Applicant :- Mahsoof
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home U.P. Civil Secrett. Lko.

And 3 Ot
Counsel for Applicant :- Ramakar Shukla
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.

1 .  Heard Sri Ramakar Shukla, the learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Manoj Kumar Sahu, the learned AGA for the State, Sri Avnish Kumar Shukla, learned counsel for the applicant and perused the record.

2. The present bail application has been filed by the applicant with the prayer to enlarge him on bail in Case Crime No. 322 of 2022, under Section 376 IPC & Section 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Jagdishpur, District Amethi.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an FIR lodged on 30.08.2022 against three named accused persons, including the applicant, alleging physical exploitation by all the accused persons.

4. In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C., she stated that she is aged 19 years, she used to talk to the applicant for the past four years and the applicant used to say that he Mahsoof vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home U.P. ... on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/95901955/
1 would marry her and he made physical relations with her.
5.

entities.text: Mahsoof vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the medico legal examination of the victim no sign of injury or use of force has been reported on any part of her body and her age has been opined to be 19 years.
6. In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., she again stated that she loves the applicant for the past four years,
In the statement of the victim's brother, he stated that the informant loved the applicant for the past four years and she wanted to marry her.

7. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the informant appears to be major and she has consistently stated that she was in love with the applicant for the past four years, coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 31.08.2022, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
8. Accordingly, this bail application is allowed.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.

Order Date :- 22.5.2023 Pradeep/-
